offence_note: Importing, trafficking and exporting drugs; firearm convictions set aside
sentence_quote: I would allow Duncan’s appeal on sentence and substitute a sentence of 14 years’ imprisonment.
note: Firearm convictions set aside; Stevenson's conviction appeal dismissed, her sentence not reviewed.

offence_note: Five aggravated assaults and weapon possession for dangerous purpose in bar fight
sentence_quote: I see no basis upon which this Court could interfere with the sentence imposed in this case, and would accordingly dismiss the appeal from sentence.
note: Near self-defence context treated as mitigating.

offence_note: Two failures to respond to curfew compliance checks
sentence_quote: The sentencing judge ordered sixty days’ incarceration, to be served intermittently, followed by two years’ probation with conditions.

offence_note: Impaired driving with prior conviction; mandatory minimum 120 days
sentence_quote: A sentence of 120 days custody is imposed, but as the respondent has served the conditional sentence, the sentence is stayed.
note: 120 days imposed but stayed because 12-month conditional sentence already served; prohibition maintained.

offence_note: Sexual assault on a bus; mischief
sentence_quote: the sentence of imprisonment plus probation on the sexual assault conviction is varied to a suspended sentence plus two years’ probation on the same terms as imposed by the trial judge.
note: Other trial-judge terms remain; mischief conviction appeal reserved but sentence varied to suspended.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery with restricted firearm; firearm possession offences
sentence_quote: Giving you credit of 33 months for the time that you have already spent in custody in relation to these offences, the resulting sentence for each offence will be as follows: Count 1, three years and nine months
note: Pre-credit sentence 6.5 years concurrent on counts 1 and 2; 4 years on counts 7 and 9.

offence_note: Trafficking and possession for trafficking of cocaine, hashish, marijuana, psilocybin
sentence_quote: The appeal against sentence is allowed and the sentence is reduced to 5 ½ years imprisonment.
note: Reduced from 7 years due to 11-year gap in record.

offence_note: Indecent act, sexual assault and sexual interference
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted and the sentence is varied to time served.
note: Reduced from 18 months; seven months already served.

offence_note: Gross indecency and sexual assault of four teenage boys, 1979-1986
sentence_quote: leave to appeal is granted and the appeal is allowed to the extent of deleting the order imposing the prohibition under 161(1)(b) of the Code.
note: Only the s. 161 prohibition was deleted; sentencing judge noted many unspecified mitigating factors.

offence_note: Burglary (identity by fingerprint) and breach of probation
sentence_quote: It was within the trial judge’s discretion to impose a consecutive sentence on the breach of probation charge.
note: Sentence length not stated; conviction and sentence appeals dismissed.

offence_note: Violent crimes involving sexual exploitation; details not shown
sentence_quote: although leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal from sentence is dismissed.
note: Offences and sentence length not shown; Metis claim unconfirmed and rejected as basis for reduction.

offence_note: Fraud on public agencies and insurer; using forged documents
sentence_quote: In summary, the total custodial sentence was 22 months.
note: Warrant of committal recommendation 'institutional setting' deleted; 18 months concurrent plus 4 months consecutive.
